retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist urban composition featuring a person rowing a bed across a body of water with a city skyline background, framed by hands holding the image.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square frame held by two hands with red nails, containing a surreal scene of a man rowing a bed like a boat on dark water against a New York-style skyline, topped with bold, stacked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The hands act as a physical frame for the inner square artwork
The dark water provides a heavy base for the floating bed subject
The verticality of the skyscrapers contrasts with the horizontal bed
The bold blue title anchors the top white section of the inner frame
coreInvariants: The central subject must be a bed used as a watercraft
The composition must be framed by hands holding the edges
The background must feature a dense metropolitan skyline

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bed is centered in the lower third; the skyline occupies the middle third; text occupies the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man rowing the bed serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold title at the top, down the skyline, to the surreal bed, then out to the framing hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top white header provides breathing room for the dense typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and grey water/skyline tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant blue title and red fingernails
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, moody lower half and the clean, bright upper half.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and heavy rounded display
letterConstructionRules: Title uses ultra-bold, rounded terminals with tight kerning
Secondary text uses a clean, high-contrast geometric sans-serif
All text is uppercase for impact
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the title is a perfect circle with a thick stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy rounded display font paired with a clean, functional geometric sans-serif for readability.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, 70s/80s display aesthetic
Appropriate for the geometric secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal photo of a man in a suit rowing a vintage bed with oars across dark choppy water. In the background, a detailed 1980s New York City skyline. Frame the entire image as if it is a square vinyl record being held by two hands with red manicured nails against a dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white rectangular block at the top of the square image. Place a large, bold, rounded blue title in the center of the white block. Below it, add two rows of black geometric sans-serif text listing names in uppercase.

verificationChecks: Is the bed clearly being rowed like a boat?
Are the hands framing the square image visible?
Is the title font heavy and rounded?
Is the skyline detailed and urban?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing artist names
Do not use specific movie titles
Ensure the bed looks like a physical object in the water
postGenerationChecks: Check that the bed's reflection or wake is visible in the water
Verify the hands are anatomically correct and holding the edges
Ensure the white header block is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the blue title is the most prominent text element
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal Subject + Urban Backdrop + Framed by Hands + Bold Rounded Header Typography
